title: Chris R NDE 736
content:
I passed out in car, awoke in an ambulance long enough to give name and address. I went out again. I felt that I was floating on an inner tube on a sun lit lake, completely surrounded by the sparkling reflections - diamond-like. I had a true feeling of peace, contentment, happiness. Then I faintly heard my name being called and a slight sensation of pressure on my chest. Reluctantly I responded and awoke in a hospital emergency room and immediately went out again. This time I found myself in the apartment I was living in at the time, which was at least sixty miles from the hospital. I was observing my roommates in the living room from my vantage point on the end of the couch, laughing to myself, knowing I could see them but they couldn't see me. Again I heard my name and pressure on my chest, and again reluctantly returned to my body.

elements.At the time of your experience, was ther: Accident carbon monoxide leak in car Clinical death
elements.The experience included: Out of body experience | Light | A landscape or city | Strong emotional tone | Special Knowledge
elements.Did you feel separated from your body?: Yes Ghost-like form of myself on edge of couch.
elements.At what time during the experience were: In and out of different realities.
elements.Did you encounter or become aware of any: Yes My room-mates, but they couldn't see me.
elements.Did you see an unearthly light?: Yes It was sparkling like the sun on water, but completely surrounding me.
elements.Did you seem to enter some other, uneart: A clearly mystical or unearthly realm Sun-lit lake.
elements.Did scenes from your past come back to y: My past flashed before me, out of my control
elements.Did you come to a border or point of no: I came to a barrier that I was not permitted to cross; or was sent back against my will Felt I had to respond to my name, even though I didn't want to.
elements.What is your religion now?: Liberal belief in god, not organized religion
elements.Did you have a change in your values and: Yes Now have no fear of death.
elements.Do you have any psychic, non-ordinary or: Uncertain Have had subsequent experiences with others near death.
elements.Are there one or several parts of your e: Best was experiencing it; worst was having to come back.
